P000.text: d. Infants pose a particular challenge. The goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained:

P001.text: (1) It is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed;

P002.text: (2) The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child. Head tilt is acceptable for infants; and

P003.text: (3) A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant.

P004.text: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

P005.text: (1) The photograph must be in color;

P006.text: (2) The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application (see 22 CFR 51.26). A photograph showing a change in hairstyle or facial hair from the identification document submitted is acceptable if it still is a good likeness of the applicant;

P007.text: NOTE: Applicants may wish to re-use a passport photograph that is depicted on their submitted U.S Certificate of Citizenship or Certificate of Naturalization. Be aware that even if the certificate itself was recently issued, because of U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services processing times, the photograph may not have been taken within six months of submitting the application.
